description: This Java source file defines the DepositProductAmountDetails class, which encapsulates details about deposit amounts for a recurring deposit product within the Apache Fineract project. It includes fields for minimum, maximum, and current deposit amounts, along with methods for creating instances, updating values based on JSON commands, and accessing the fields.
